sentence: From 2022-02-17 to 2026-11-18 (239 weekly decisions, both traded at the open), labels set with the pre-market price returned +38.3% a year (worst drawdown -35.5%) against +36.5% (-34.9%) for labels set at the previous close; the two agreed on 89% of stock-weeks.
